THE SCENE

You are making a short video for the school art show. It is about one page copied from an old notebook of poems. The poem is in Chinese, and it has no name. Your class calls it the ghost page. You need four answers to finish the video. Four people each can help you.

THE HISTORY

This video is about Angel Island, near San Francisco. From 1910 to 1940, many people from China waited there. Some carved poems into the wooden walls. Two men later copied many of the poems into notebooks.
